language-save-failed: The language could not be saved. Your previous language is still selected. Try again.
language-load-failed: Your language setting could not be loaded. Using the system language where supported.
language-invalid-settings: Your saved language setting is invalid. Using the system language where supported.
language-incomplete: Translation and RTL support are being introduced. Some areas are still in English.
welcome-tagline: Your novel, as plain markdown files.
date-error-not-day-number: “$1” isn’t a day number. In a day-count project, write a whole number like 14.
date-error-too-large: $1 is too large to work with.
date-error-not-date: “$1” isn’t a date. Write YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date-error-invalid-day: $1: that day doesn’t exist in that month.
warnings-intro: Plot Device never changes files because of these. Fix them in the app or in any editor; this list updates as you do.
warnings-group-links: Links that could mean two files
problem-unreadable-file: Can't be read. Check the file's permissions.
problem-invalid-encoding: Not saved as UTF-8 text, so it is left untouched.
problem-unclosed-frontmatter: The frontmatter block is never closed with ---.
problem-unparseable-frontmatter: The frontmatter isn't valid YAML, so it is left untouched.
problem-unknown-type: Unknown type "$1", so it is listed as untyped.
problem-nested-project: Another project (has its own novel.md). Its files are not part of this one.
problem-name-breaks-links: The file name contains # ^ [ ] or |, so links to it don’t work. Rename it.
warning-novel-unreadable-file: novel.md can't be read (check its permissions). The project is open read-only until it is fixed.
warning-novel-invalid-encoding: novel.md is not valid UTF-8. The project is open read-only until it is fixed.
warning-novel-unclosed-frontmatter: novel.md has a frontmatter block that is never closed. The project is open read-only until it is fixed.
warning-novel-unparseable-frontmatter: novel.md has frontmatter that is not valid YAML. The project is open read-only until it is fixed.
warning-format-invalid: "format" should be a whole number, not $1; assuming 1.
warning-format-newer: This project uses format $1, which is newer than this app supports. It is open read-only.
warning-settings-invalid: "settings" should be a mapping; using defaults.
warning-setting-file-name-sync: $1 should be ask, always, or never, not $2; using the default.
warning-setting-boolean: $1 should be true or false, not $2; using the default.
warning-setting-folder-mapping: $1 should be a mapping of entry types to folders, not $2; using the default.
warning-setting-visible-folder: $1 should be a folder inside the project, not hidden, not $2; using the default.
warning-part-without-order: Not in the numbered sequence (no order): $1.
warning-ambiguous-body: $1: $2 in the text could mean $3. Write it with its folder, like $4.
warning-ambiguous-key: $1: $2 in $3 could mean $4. Write it with its folder, like $5.
warning-unquoted-link: $1: $2 isn’t in quotes, so YAML reads it as a list. Write $3.
warning-not-link: $1: $2 should be a link like "[[Name]]", not $3.
warning-not-integer: $1: $2 should be a whole number, not $3.
